changelog: App update checker: a dialog now appears when a new version is released, with the full changelog and a download button.
Fixed the header '⬆ Updates' button — it was rendered as a cramped circle; now it is a proper pill-shaped text button.
Deleting a course in the admin panel now also removes it from the shared-hub git branch.
Sync no longer reports courses as updated when shared-exercises is empty or installation fails.
30 exercise types: audio, video, text, speaking and more (see TEST QWEN GEN demo course).
Shared hub sync via GitHub branch shared-hub.
Admin panel (Konami code) to publish/edit/delete courses in the hub.
Dark theme, search, offline file:// mode.
